title: Emerald Velvet Handcrafted Abaya
subtitle: Royal Winter Velvet & Handworked Zardozi
description: Exquisite micro-velvet abaya in rich deep emerald green, accentuated with hand-embellished zardozi cuffs and a cascading drape.
longDescription: A masterpiece from AMabaya's Winter Royalty Edition. Designed for winter festivities, weddings, and formal occasions.
